## Home and the stream menu

- **Playing Now:** a new first row on Home with the games running on your PC, whether this device or another one started them. It only shows while something is running.
- **Stream menu:** it now scrolls with your finger when it doesn't fit the screen, and the Controls (Touch Mode, On-Screen Controls, Swap A/B and X/Y) have their own page, Controls, next to Stream Settings, which keeps the video settings.
